subject: POC onramp: align calendars & owners for kickoff (Elliot Systems)
messages:
From: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@elliot.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elliot.com, security@elliot.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC onramp: proposed kickoff windows + attendees

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. We'd like to lock a first POC kickoff with Redwood next to go over success criteria and owners so we can get sign-off from procurement/security and schedule the hands-on sessions. Tentative attendees from our side: myself (platform lead), Maya Chen (eng lead), procurement@elliot.com, and security@elliot.com.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 23, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 24, 09:00–10:00

If those don't work, happy to propose the following week. Attached is a short spreadsheet with our preliminary requirements (Elliot_POC_requirements.xlsx).

Top goals for us at kickoff:
- Agree success criteria for the POC (throughput / latency targets, data handling)
- Assign owners for integration and security evidence collection
- Confirm timeline for a 3-week POC and a go/no-go decision gate

Can your AE/SE join the call? We specifically want an SE who can answer infra/quantization questions.

Thanks,
Chris
Chris Lowe
Platform Lead, Elliot Systems
chris.lowe@elliot.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@elliot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, procurement@elliot.com, security@elliot.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 17:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed kickoff windows + attendees

Hi Chris — appreciated the context and the attachment. Ben (AE) and Ava (SE) are available to run the kickoff and the technical deep-dive.

Quick availability from our side (PST):
- Tue Nov 23: Ava available 14:00–15:30, Ben available 09:00–12:00
- Fri Nov 26: 10:00–11:30 (flex)
- Mon Nov 29: full-day availability

If security needs a pre-call to cover evidence (SOC2 / data flow), we can schedule a short 30-min slot the day before the kickoff.

Would you be able to confirm:
1) Which of your suggested attendees will own procurement + invoice contact?
2) Any mandatory success criteria (SLA numbers, sample dataset size) to include in the kickoff agenda?
3) Do you prefer a Google Meet or a dial-in?

I attached our Redwood POC checklist (redwood-poc-success-criteria.pdf) to use as a starting point. I also created a placeholder calendar option (link below) — once we confirm a slot I will send the invite with an agenda and owners.

Looking forward to aligning.

—
Soojin Lee
Revenue Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@elliot.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elliot.com, security@elliot.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed kickoff windows + attendees

Thanks Soojin — quick update: exec calendar just opened and they pushed a board review into Nov 23, so the earlier windows won't work. Apologies for the churn.

New preferred time: Mon Nov 29, 11:00–12:30 PST. That gives us time to prep internal folks.

Procurement is confirmed as procurement@elliot.com and they'll want an itemized estimate for dedicated capacity and an estimate for egress/embedding usage. Security wants to validate data residency and audit log retention during the POC — they asked if Redwood can provide a lightweight evidence packet ahead of the kickoff.

Could Ben/AVA confirm if Nov 29 11:00–12:30 works? Also, if Rishi from your security team can join or at least provide the evidence packet, that would be great.

On quoting: we have an internal procurement lead (Amy Park) — I can loop her if you want procurement-specific docs.

Thanks,
Chris

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@elliot.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@elliot.com, security@elliot.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed kickoff windows + attendees

Chris / team — Nov 29 11:00 PST works for us. Ava will lead the SE portion and I will own procurement questions & pricing walkthrough. Rishi, can you confirm whether you can join the kickoff or if you prefer we send the evidence packet first?

For procurement: I'll prepare an itemized estimate (Dedicated capacity / burst / token-based cost buckets) and a one-page procurement summary for Amy. If you can share Amy's email I will send the docs ahead of time.

Agenda draft for the kickoff (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (5)
- POC scope & success criteria (10)
- Technical architecture & infra Qs (15)
- Procurement & timeline next steps (10)

If that looks good we'll lock Nov 29 11:00–12:30 and I'll push the calendar invite with the agenda.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@elliot.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@elliot.com, security@elliot.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onramp: proposed kickoff windows + attendees

Locking Nov 29, 11:00–12:30 PST for the Elliot Systems POC kickoff. Calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) attached and Google Meet link added to the event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Attachments included: redwood-poc-success-criteria.pdf (editable checklist) and the calendar .ics. Ben will share the procurement one-pager and itemized estimate by EOD Nov 20. Rishi will circulate a short evidence packet for security (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, audit log retention) before Nov 27.

Please confirm receipt and add any additional owners to the invite. Below are the agreed owners:
- Redwood AE: Ben Carter — procurement & timeline
- Redwood SE: Ava Chen — technical lead for POC runbooks
- Elliot eng owner: Maya Chen — integration lead
- Elliot procurement: Amy Park (please share email)
- Security evidence: security@elliot.com (to confirm contact)

Expected POC timeline: 3 weeks (kickoff, integration week, runbook + validation week). Success criteria will live in the attached checklist and we'll iterate during kickoff.

DocuSign link for mutual NDA + minimal SOW: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/12345 (we can add SOW after kickoff if you prefer). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-3245

Thanks all — see you Nov 29.

—
Soojin Lee
Revenue Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
